name: Ponta Delgada · Azores
tagline: Crater lakes, hot springs and whales mid-Atlantic
summary: Ponta Delgada is the gateway to São Miguel, the largest island of the Azores. Volcanic crater lakes, steaming hot springs, tea plantations and whale-watching trips make it one of Europe's best nature escapes.
seasonNote: Summer is warmest and calmest. Weather changes fast all year; bring layers. Whales are seen year-round, with most species in spring.
arrival: Ponta Delgada Airport has flights from Lisbon (about 2 hours) and some from North America.
gettingAround: Rent a car; buses are limited.
cashTip: Cards and contactless work almost everywhere; carry a few euros for cafés, markets and small boats.
foodTip: Cozido das Furnas cooked in volcanic ground, limpets, local cheese and pineapple.
buyTip: Gorreana tea, Azorean pineapples and São Jorge cheese.
